nf6a64f7d47.headline: COMESA Central Bank Governors Discuss Monetary Integration
nf6a64f7d47.summary: The 24th meeting of COMESA central bank governors in Lusaka focused on enhancing implementation of the monetary integration agenda and regional free trade programs.
nf6a64f7d47.why: COMESA is a major regional economic bloc in Eastern and Southern Africa aiming to deepen monetary and trade integration, which can impact regional economic growth and investment.
